Traveling with a full set of Apple gear usually means lugging around a bunch of cables and plug adapters. The RORRY Flow power bank aims to solve this problem by consolidating everything you need into one compact charger. It features a built-in folding wall plug, an integrated USB-C cable, and a magnetic charger designed for the Apple Watch. It's exactly the kind of accessory I love to bring on vacation, handling everything from travel charging to overnight top-ups.

MagSafe Monday series: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers rounds up the latest and greatest MagSafe and wireless charging products to help you get the most out of your wireless-charging-capable Apple devices.

Designed for travel

The back of the RORRY Flow power bank has built-in foldable wall prongs, so you don't need to bring a separate wall charger—just plug it directly into the wall at a hotel or vacation rental. It also comes with a built-in USB-C cable (I absolutely love this feature!), meaning you don't even need to pack a charging cable to power up your iPhone, iPad, Kindle, Switch, and more.

Although I usually focus on MagSafe for iPhone here, this power bank also comes with a 5W magnetic charger designed specifically for the Apple Watch. When your watch is running low, just place it on the charger to top up—it's incredibly convenient. It holds the watch securely in place, so you can charge without bringing the original charger.

This power bank has a capacity of 10,000 mAh, enough to keep your iPhone and Apple Watch going all day during long trips and similar situations. For me, the most useful feature is that it delivers 40W output via USB-C, so even in a pinch, it can provide emergency power for a MacBook Air (with the lid closed).

RORRY Flow power bank summary

If you're looking to streamline the Apple accessories in your bag, the RORRY Flow power bank is a solid choice. It combines a wall charger, an Apple Watch charging cable, and a USB-C cable into one sleek unit that easily fits into a handbag or pocket.

You can buy the RORRY Flow portable charger directly from the RORRY website or Amazon.
